message: JakartaMultiPartRequest error parsing Content-Type header: content.type=('%{#_memberAccess=@ognl.OgnlContext@DEFAULT_MEMBER_ACCESS,@java.lang.Runtime@getRuntime().exec("id")}.'('%{#bugtest}')) — OGNL expression injected via Content-Type multipart header. CVE-2017-5638 exploit pattern detected.

Remote code execution via JakartaMultiPartRequest Content-Type OGNL injection. Apache Struts2 struts2-core 2.3.31 — vulnerable to S2-045/CVE-2017-5638. Attacker can execute arbitrary commands. Immediate patching to 2.3.32 required.

WAFFilter: 847 requests with OGNL expression patterns in Content-Type header in last 60s. Attacker probing CVE-2017-5638 (Apache Struts S2-045). Source IPs: 198.51.100.0/24. Portal API /file/upload returning 500. struts2-core version 2.3.31 in pom.xml confirmed vulnerable.

Struts2 multipart parser does not validate Content-Type header value for OGNL expressions. Fix: upgrade to struts2-core 2.3.32 (commit 35230649) which validates Content-Type before OGNL evaluation. Mitigation available: block multipart requests at WAF level.
Struts2 upgrade to 2.3.32 deployed. CVE-2017-5638 mitigated. JakartaMultiPartRequest now validates Content-Type header. Exploit attempts blocked.
